status_semantics: No field named status. This record freezes the row-pairing tool before it is used on production output.
position_in_chain: frozen DEC v1 + DEC gate -> frozen RA v1 + RA gate -> THIS JOINER -> FK4(B1950) to FK5(J2000) per row -> sealed B1 comparison -> eligible manifest
why_it_is_frozen_before_use: The joiner decides which declination and which right ascension belong to the same physical observation. A wrong pairing would put a real declination next to another row's right ascension, and the epoch transform would then produce a coordinate that never existed. That error would be invisible downstream, so the pairing rule is fixed before it sees production data.

the_key.primary: (source_page, row_y), where row_y is the full band [y0, y1] and equality is exact
the_key.secondary: row_index, recorded and compared, never used to pair
the_key.why_not_index: The two extractors segment each page independently, so the same index can denote different physical rows. The project already lost a validation result to index-shift ambiguity in a scoring harness; the rule exists because of that.

verdict_vocabulary.PAIRED: same page and identical row_y on both sides
verdict_vocabulary.PAIRING_UNRESOLVED: row_y duplicated on either side; every copy is unresolved
verdict_vocabulary.UNPAIRED_DEC_ONLY: declination row with no right ascension row at that exact row_y
verdict_vocabulary.UNPAIRED_RA_ONLY: right ascension row with no declination row at that exact row_y
verdict_vocabulary.PAGE_MISSING_ON_OTHER_SIDE: the page itself is absent from the other side

design_stance: The joiner prefers to leave a hundred rows unresolved over pairing one physical row wrongly. Differing row counts on a page are NOT treated as an error in themselves; each row_y is evaluated individually.

cases: row_y shifted block of two pixels: zero pairings, six unpaired
rows out of order: paired by geometry, three index disagreements recorded
page present on one side only
page-level record with no row_y, skipped and counted separately
differing row counts with exact overlap
fixture_suite.most_important: The shifted-block fixture. A systematic two-pixel offset produces zero pairings rather than twelve wrong ones. That is the failure the joiner exists to prevent.
fixture_suite.synthetic_only: The fixtures contain no archive data and make no scientific statement.

hashes.computed_by: Owner, Get-FileHash on the project copy, 2026-08-19. Recorded here in lowercase; same digest.
hashes.committed_in: git commit 63f8ad3, tools: add exact geometric RA-Dec row pairing

what_it_does_not_do: No comparison against the sealed B1 window.
No scientific classification of any kind.
immutability_rule: This version is never modified in place. Any change is a new version with its own freeze record and its own fixture run, so that joined output remains attributable to the exact pairing rule that produced it.
